item.title: Entergy Mississippi outages down to 14K ahead of more cold weather
item.description: JACKSON, Miss. (WJTV) - Entergy announced on Friday that crews have restored power to 68% of customers affected by last weekend's winter storm. The storm disrupted electrical service for approximately 171,200 customers across Entergy's service territory.
